### Select an observed agent
Select a row. The picker contains up to **200 most recently observed IDs** in the selected window; its search filters only those rows. Use manual entry for an absent or inventory-only ID. Invocation identity means **target**, not caller.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let WindowStart = {TimeRange:start};
let WindowEnd = {TimeRange:end};
let CleanId = (value:string) {
    let s = trim(@"\s+", value);
    iff(s in~ ("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", "N/A"), "",
        iff(s matches regex @"^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
            tolower(s), s))
};
let PlatformKey = (value:string) { tolower(replace_regex(value, @"[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "")) };
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp >= WindowStart and Timestamp < WindowEnd
| where ActionType in ("InvokeAgent", "InferenceCall", "AISpanOutput",
    "ExecuteToolBySDK", "ExecuteToolByGateway", "ExecuteToolByMCPServer")
| project Timestamp, ActionType, RawEventData
| extend R = RawEventData, C = parse_json(tostring(RawEventData.CopilotEventData))
| extend AgentId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.TargetAgentId),
        coalesce(tostring(R.AgentId), tostring(C.AgentId)))),
    NativeId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.PlatformTargetAgentId),
        coalesce(tostring(R.PlatformAgentId), tostring(C.PlatformAgentId)))),
    AgentName = iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.TargetAgentName),
        coalesce(tostring(R.AgentName), tostring(C.AgentName))),
    AgentPlatform = iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.PlatformTargetAgentType),
        coalesce(tostring(R.PlatformAgentType), tostring(R.AgentPlatform), tostring(C.PlatformAgentType))),
    BlueprintId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent",
        coalesce(tostring(R.TargetAgentBlueprintId), tostring(R.TargetAgentBlueprintID), tostring(R.TargetBlueprintId)),
        tostring(R.AgentBlueprintId)))
| extend SelectedId = coalesce(AgentId, NativeId)
| where isnotempty(SelectedId)
| summarize Events = count(), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    Names = make_set_if(AgentName, isnotempty(AgentName), 8),
    Platforms = make_set_if(AgentPlatform, isnotempty(AgentPlatform), 8),
    IdentityKinds = make_set(iff(isnotempty(AgentId), "AgentId", "Platform-native ID"), 2)
    by SelectedId
| top 200 by LastSeen desc
| project Agent = iff(array_length(Names) > 0, strcat_array(Names, ", "), "(name not reported)"),
    AgentId = SelectedId, Platforms, Events, LastSeen, IdentityKinds"}

content.json:
## Selected agent | Security overview
**Window:** {TimeRange:label}. **Activity:** {ActionFocus:label}. Counts are telemetry observations, not successful operations. Click a tool row to scope the optional raw-evidence query. Account roles and blueprint relationships remain separate.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let WindowStart = {TimeRange:start};
let WindowEnd = {TimeRange:end};
let CleanId = (value:string) {
    let s = trim(@"\s+", value);
    iff(s in~ ("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", "N/A"), "",
        iff(s matches regex @"^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
            tolower(s), s))
};
let PlatformKey = (value:string) { tolower(replace_regex(value, @"[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "")) };

let SelectedId = CleanId(iff("{InputMode}" == "Manual", base64_decode_tostring("{ManualAgentId:base64}"), base64_decode_tostring("{PickedAgentId:base64}")));
let ScopedEvents = () {
    CloudAppEvents
    | where isnotempty(SelectedId)
    | where Timestamp >= WindowStart and Timestamp < WindowEnd
    | where ActionType in ("InvokeAgent", "InferenceCall", "AISpanOutput",
        "ExecuteToolBySDK", "ExecuteToolByGateway", "ExecuteToolByMCPServer")
    | project Timestamp, ActionType, RawEventData, AdditionalFields, AccountObjectId, AccountId,
        AccountDisplayName, AccountType, Application, IPAddress, CountryCode,
        IsExternalUser, IsAnonymousProxy, IsImpersonated
| where "{ActionFocus}" == "All" or ActionType == "{ActionFocus}"
| extend R = RawEventData, C = parse_json(tostring(RawEventData.CopilotEventData))
| extend AgentId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.TargetAgentId),
        coalesce(tostring(R.AgentId), tostring(C.AgentId)))),
    NativeId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.PlatformTargetAgentId),
        coalesce(tostring(R.PlatformAgentId), tostring(C.PlatformAgentId)))),
    AgentName = iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.TargetAgentName),
        coalesce(tostring(R.AgentName), tostring(C.AgentName))),
    AgentPlatform = iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.PlatformTargetAgentType),
        coalesce(tostring(R.PlatformAgentType), tostring(R.AgentPlatform), tostring(C.PlatformAgentType))),
    BlueprintId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent",
        coalesce(tostring(R.TargetAgentBlueprintId), tostring(R.TargetAgentBlueprintID), tostring(R.TargetBlueprintId)),
        tostring(R.AgentBlueprintId)))
    | where AgentId == SelectedId or NativeId == SelectedId
};
let Events = materialize(
    ScopedEvents()
    | extend ToolName = coalesce(tostring(R.ToolName), tostring(R.toolName), tostring(R["gen_ai.tool.name"])),
        ToolType = tostring(R.ToolType), ToolServer = tostring(R.ToolServerName),
        ServerAddress = tostring(R.ServerAddress), ToolDescription = tostring(R.ToolDescription),
        ToolId = tostring(R.ToolId), TraceId = coalesce(tostring(R.TraceId), tostring(C.TraceId), tostring(R.traceId)),
        ConversationId = coalesce(tostring(R.ConversationId), tostring(C.ConversationId)),
        ThreadId = coalesce(tostring(R.ThreadId), tostring(C.ThreadId)),
        RequestId = coalesce(tostring(R.RequestId), tostring(C.RequestId)),
        SpanId = tostring(R.OpId), ParentSpanId = tostring(R.ParentId),
        RawUserId = tostring(R.UserId), RawUserKey = CleanId(tostring(R.UserKey)),
        TargetUserId = tostring(R.TargetAgentUserId), TargetUserKey = CleanId(tostring(R.TargetAgentUserKey)),
        ErrorMessage = coalesce(tostring(R.ErrorMessage), tostring(C.ErrorMessage)),
        ErrorCode = coalesce(tostring(R.ErrorCode), tostring(R.ErrorType), tostring(C.ErrorType)),
        Channel = coalesce(tostring(R.ChannelName), tostring(C.ChannelName)),
        ModelMetadata = parse_json(tostring(C.ModelTransparencyDetails)),
        SpanStart = todatetime(R.CreationTime),
        SpanEnd = coalesce(todatetime(R.CompletionTime), todatetime(C.CompletionTime)),
        Satellite = tobool(AdditionalFields.IsSatelliteProvider),
        TraceConflict = isnotempty(tostring(R.TraceId)) and isnotempty(tostring(C.TraceId))
            and tostring(R.TraceId) != tostring(C.TraceId),
        ConversationConflict = isnotempty(tostring(R.ConversationId)) and isnotempty(tostring(C.ConversationId))
            and tostring(R.ConversationId) != tostring(C.ConversationId)
    | extend HasError = isnotempty(ErrorMessage) or isnotempty(ErrorCode),
        NormalizedAccount = coalesce(CleanId(AccountObjectId), AccountId),
        RawUser = coalesce(RawUserKey, RawUserId),
        TargetUser = coalesce(TargetUserKey, TargetUserId),
        DurationMs = iff(isnotnull(SpanStart) and isnotnull(SpanEnd) and SpanEnd >= SpanStart,
            datetime_diff("millisecond", SpanEnd, SpanStart), long(null)),
        InvalidDuration = isnotnull(SpanStart) and isnotnull(SpanEnd) and SpanEnd < SpanStart,
        ToolPhase = case(ToolType startswith "MCP:Initialize", "MCP initialization",
            ToolType startswith "MCP:ListTools", "MCP discovery",
            ToolType startswith "MCP:CallTool", "Explicit MCP call",
            ToolType =~ "function", "Function observation",
            ToolType =~ "RemoteMCP", "Remote MCP observation",
            ToolType =~ "CodefulServer", "Server observation", "Other / unspecified")
    | project Timestamp, ActionType, AgentId, NativeId, AgentName, AgentPlatform, BlueprintId,
        Channel, Application, ToolName, ToolType, ToolServer, ServerAddress, ToolDescription, ToolId,
        TraceId, ConversationId, ThreadId, RequestId, SpanId, ParentSpanId,
        AccountObjectId, AccountId, AccountDisplayName, AccountType, NormalizedAccount,
        RawUser, RawUserId, RawUserKey, TargetUser, TargetUserId, TargetUserKey,
        ErrorMessage, ErrorCode, HasError, IPAddress, CountryCode, IsExternalUser,
        IsAnonymousProxy, IsImpersonated, ModelMetadata, DurationMs, InvalidDuration,
        Satellite, TraceConflict, ConversationConflict, ToolPhase
);
let ToolCount = toscalar(Events | where ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool" and isnotempty(ToolName)
    | distinct ToolName | count);
let S = materialize(Events
| summarize Total = count(), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    Invocations = countif(ActionType == "InvokeAgent"), Inference = countif(ActionType == "InferenceCall"),
    ToolEvents = countif(ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool"), Outputs = countif(ActionType == "AISpanOutput"),
    ErrorEvents = countif(HasError), AdminEvents = countif(AccountType =~ "Admin"),
    WithTrace = countif(isnotempty(TraceId)), WithAccountObjectId = countif(isnotempty(AccountObjectId)),
    WithNormalizedAccount = countif(isnotempty(NormalizedAccount)), WithRawUser = countif(isnotempty(RawUser)),
    WithTargetUser = countif(ActionType == "InvokeAgent" and isnotempty(TargetUser)),
    WithModel = countif(ActionType == "InferenceCall" and tostring(ModelMetadata) !in ("", "[]", "{}", "null")),
    WithDuration = countif(ActionType == "InferenceCall" and isnotnull(DurationMs)),
    InvalidDurations = countif(InvalidDuration), TraceConflicts = countif(TraceConflict),
    ConversationConflicts = countif(ConversationConflict), ExternalEvents = countif(IsExternalUser == true),
    ProxyEvents = countif(IsAnonymousProxy == true), ImpersonatedEvents = countif(IsImpersonated == true),
    SatelliteReported = countif(isnotnull(Satellite)), SatelliteTrue = countif(Satellite == true),
    Names = make_set_if(AgentName, isnotempty(AgentName), 32),
    Platforms = make_set_if(AgentPlatform, isnotempty(AgentPlatform), 32),
    AgentIds = make_set_if(AgentId, isnotempty(AgentId), 32),
    NativeIds = make_set_if(NativeId, isnotempty(NativeId), 32),
    Blueprints = make_set_if(BlueprintId, isnotempty(BlueprintId), 32),
    Channels = make_set_if(Channel, isnotempty(Channel), 32),
    Applications = make_set_if(Application, isnotempty(Application), 32),
    Conversations = dcountif(ConversationId, isnotempty(ConversationId))
);
let Profile = S
| extend Properties = bag_pack("Selected ID", SelectedId, "Observed names", Names,
    "Platforms", Platforms, "Channels", Channels, "Applications", Applications,
    "First observed in window (UTC)", FirstSeen, "Last observed in window (UTC)", LastSeen,
    "Executing / target IDs", AgentIds, "Native IDs", NativeIds, "Blueprint references", Blueprints,
    "Identity scope", case(array_length(AgentIds) > 1, "Multiple executing IDs match this input; review native-ID ambiguity.",
        array_length(Platforms) > 1, "One selected identity with multiple platform labels; not automatically an identity collision.",
        "Exact executing/target or native ID; caller-only invocations excluded."),
    "Visibility", iff(Total == 0, "No observed events in this window. Not proof of inactivity.",
        "Observed telemetry; counts are not successful operations."),
    "Conversation IDs (approximate)", Conversations)
| mv-expand Label = bag_keys(Properties) to typeof(string)
| project View = "Profile", Label, Value = tostring(Properties[Label]);
let Kpis = S
| extend Cards = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Label", "Observed events", "Value", tostring(Total), "Note", "All selected event families", "Order", 1),
    bag_pack("Label", "Observed tool names", "Value", tostring(ToolCount), "Note", "Distinct names, not calls", "Order", 2),
    bag_pack("Label", "Admin-associated events", "Value", tostring(AdminEvents), "Note", "Reported AccountType; not effective privilege", "Order", 3),
    bag_pack("Label", "Error-bearing events", "Value", tostring(ErrorEvents), "Note", "Not deduplicated failed operations", "Order", 4),
    bag_pack("Label", "Trace coverage", "Value", iff(Total == 0, "N/A", strcat(round(100.0 * WithTrace / Total, 1), "%")),
        "Note", "Nonempty extracted TraceId", "Order", 5),
    bag_pack("Label", "Inference events", "Value", tostring(Inference), "Note", "Model identity may be unreported", "Order", 6))
| mv-expand Card = Cards
| project View = "Kpis", Label = tostring(Card.Label), Value = tostring(Card.Value),
    Evidence = tostring(Card.Note), Sort = tolong(Card.Order);
let Grain = case(WindowEnd - WindowStart <= 6h, 5m, WindowEnd - WindowStart <= 1d, 30m,
    WindowEnd - WindowStart <= 7d, 3h, 12h);
let Timeline = Events
| summarize Invocations = countif(ActionType == "InvokeAgent"),
    Inference = countif(ActionType == "InferenceCall"), Tools = countif(ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool"),
    Outputs = countif(ActionType == "AISpanOutput") by Time = bin(Timestamp, Grain)
| project View = "Timeline", Time, Invocations, Inference, Tools, Outputs;
let Findings = union
    (S | where Total == 0 | project View = "Findings", Category = "Visibility", Label = "No activity in this window",
        Value = "No selected events returned", Evidence = "This does not establish inactivity or missing controls.",
        NextStep = "Check the ID and deliberately widen the time window.", Sort = long(0)),
    (S | where ErrorEvents > 0 | project View = "Findings", Category = "Investigate", Label = "Reported errors",
        Value = strcat(ErrorEvents, " error-bearing events"), Evidence = "An operation may be reported at multiple layers.",
        NextStep = "Review the error groups and tool reporting layers below.", Sort = long(1)),
    (S | where AdminEvents > 0 | project View = "Findings", Category = "Review", Label = "Admin-associated activity",
        Value = strcat(AdminEvents, " events"), Evidence = "AccountType is a reported label, not proof of privilege use.",
        NextStep = "Review normalized event accounts, actions and tools; verify permissions separately.", Sort = long(2)),
    (S | where Total > 0 and WithTrace < Total | project View = "Findings", Category = "Visibility", Label = "Incomplete trace coverage",
        Value = strcat(Total - WithTrace, " events without TraceId"), Evidence = "Conversation, request and span IDs remain separate pivots.",
        NextStep = "Inspect instrumentation. Do not reconstruct complete runs from timestamps alone.", Sort = long(3)),
    (S | where Inference > WithModel | project View = "Findings", Category = "Visibility", Label = "Model metadata not reported",
        Value = strcat(Inference - WithModel, " of ", Inference, " inference events"),
        Evidence = "Expected source: CopilotEventData.ModelTransparencyDetails.",
        NextStep = "Check emitter metadata; do not infer the model from tool or agent names.", Sort = long(4)),
    (S | where Total > WithAccountObjectId | project View = "Findings", Category = "Visibility", Label = "Incomplete account object IDs",
        Value = strcat(Total - WithAccountObjectId, " events"), Evidence = "AccountId and raw user fields can still be populated.",
        NextStep = "Compare the three reported account roles below. Missing object IDs do not mean anonymous.", Sort = long(5)),
    (S | where ExternalEvents + ProxyEvents + ImpersonatedEvents > 0
        | project View = "Findings", Category = "Review", Label = "Reported account/network signals",
        Value = strcat("External: ", ExternalEvents, "; proxy: ", ProxyEvents, "; impersonated: ", ImpersonatedEvents),
        Evidence = "Signals can overlap; service accounts and notifications need context.",
        NextStep = "Inspect event evidence and expected behavior before classifying a threat.", Sort = long(6)),
    (S | where TraceConflicts + ConversationConflicts + InvalidDurations > 0
        | project View = "Findings", Category = "Visibility", Label = "Telemetry consistency",
        Value = strcat("Trace conflicts: ", TraceConflicts, "; conversation conflicts: ", ConversationConflicts,
            "; invalid durations: ", InvalidDurations),
        Evidence = "These are telemetry quality findings, not validated detections.",
        NextStep = "Compare raw/nested correlation fields and reported timestamps.", Sort = long(7));
let Tools = materialize(Events
| where ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool"
| summarize Count = count(), Errors = countif(HasError), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    Layers = make_set(strcat(ActionType, " / ", ToolPhase), 8),
    Servers = make_set_if(ToolServer, isnotempty(ToolServer), 8),
    Addresses = make_set_if(ServerAddress, isnotempty(ServerAddress), 8),
    Descriptions = make_set_if(ToolDescription, isnotempty(ToolDescription), 4),
    SetupEvents = countif(ToolPhase in ("MCP initialization", "MCP discovery")),
    ToolIdsReported = countif(isnotempty(ToolId))
    by ToolName
| extend Label = coalesce(ToolName, "(name not reported)"),
    Category = case(ToolName contains "mail" or ToolName contains "message", "Mail-related (name-inferred)",
        ToolName in~ ("findSite", "findFileOrFolder"), "SharePoint discovery (name-inferred)",
        ToolName contains "profile", "Identity/profile (name-inferred)", "Unclassified")
| order by Errors desc, Count desc, Label asc
| take 50
| project View = "Tools", Label, Category, Count, Errors, LastSeen,
    Evidence = "Names/descriptions do not prove permissions or data retrieval. Events are not deduplicated calls.",
    Details = bag_pack("ReportingLayers", Layers, "ToolServers", Servers, "ReportedAddresses", Addresses,
        "Descriptions", Descriptions, "SetupDiscoveryEvents", SetupEvents, "EventsWithToolId", ToolIdsReported));
let Layers = Events
| where ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool"
| summarize Count = count(), Errors = countif(HasError), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by ToolName, ActionType, ToolPhase, ToolType, ToolServer, ServerAddress
| order by Errors desc, Count desc
| take 100
| project View = "Layers", Label = coalesce(ToolName, "(name not reported)"), ActionType,
    Category = ToolPhase, ToolType, ToolServer, ServerAddress, Count, Errors, LastSeen;
let Associations = materialize(Events
| extend Identities = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Role", "Normalized event account", "Identity", NormalizedAccount,
        "Name", coalesce(AccountDisplayName, NormalizedAccount), "AccountType", AccountType,
        "Source", "AccountObjectId / AccountId / AccountDisplayName"),
    bag_pack("Role", "Raw reported user", "Identity", RawUser,
        "Name", coalesce(RawUserId, RawUser), "AccountType", "",
        "Source", "RawEventData.UserKey / UserId"),
    bag_pack("Role", "Target agent user", "Identity", TargetUser,
        "Name", coalesce(TargetUserId, TargetUser), "AccountType", "",
        "Source", "RawEventData.TargetAgentUserKey / TargetAgentUserId"))
| mv-expand IdentityEntry = Identities
| extend Identity = tostring(IdentityEntry.Identity), Role = tostring(IdentityEntry.Role),
    Name = tostring(IdentityEntry.Name), ReportedType = tostring(IdentityEntry.AccountType),
    Source = tostring(IdentityEntry.Source)
| where isnotempty(Identity)
| summarize Count = count(), Errors = countif(HasError), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    Names = make_set(Name, 8), Types = make_set_if(ReportedType, isnotempty(ReportedType), 8),
    Actions = make_set(ActionType, 8), ToolNames = make_set_if(ToolName, isnotempty(ToolName), 16),
    IPs = make_set_if(IPAddress, isnotempty(IPAddress), 16),
    Countries = make_set_if(CountryCode, isnotempty(CountryCode), 16),
    ExternalSignals = countif(IsExternalUser == true), ProxySignals = countif(IsAnonymousProxy == true),
    ImpersonatedSignals = countif(IsImpersonated == true)
    by Role, Identity, Source
| extend Label = strcat_array(Names, ", "));
let Accounts = Associations
| order by Count desc, Role asc, Identity asc
| take 50
| project View = "Accounts", Label, Role, Identity, Count, Errors, LastSeen, Evidence = Source,
    Details = bag_pack("ReportedAccountTypes", Types, "ActionTypes", Actions, "ObservedTools", ToolNames,
        "IPs", IPs, "Countries", Countries, "ExternalSignals", ExternalSignals,
        "ProxySignals", ProxySignals, "ImpersonatedSignals", ImpersonatedSignals);
let Models = Events
| where ActionType == "InferenceCall"
| extend ModelEntries = case(gettype(ModelMetadata) == "array" and array_length(ModelMetadata) > 0, ModelMetadata,
    gettype(ModelMetadata) == "dictionary" and array_length(bag_keys(ModelMetadata)) > 0, pack_array(ModelMetadata),
    dynamic([{}]))
| mv-expand Entry = ModelEntries
| extend Label = coalesce(tostring(Entry.ModelName), "(model not reported)"),
    Category = coalesce(tostring(Entry.ModelProviderName), "(provider not reported)")
| summarize Count = count(), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), ValidDurations = countif(isnotnull(DurationMs)),
    AverageMs = avg(DurationMs), P95Ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by Label, Category
| top 30 by Count desc
| project View = "Models", Label, Category, Count, LastSeen,
    Evidence = "Metadata entries, not unique calls; a multi-model event can appear more than once.",
    Details = bag_pack("ValidDurationEntries", ValidDurations, "AverageReportedMs", AverageMs, "P95ReportedMs", P95Ms);
let Coverage = S
| extend Measures = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Label", "Trace ID", "Reported", WithTrace, "Eligible", Total),
    bag_pack("Label", "Normalized account object ID", "Reported", WithAccountObjectId, "Eligible", Total),
    bag_pack("Label", "Normalized account ID (object ID or AccountId)", "Reported", WithNormalizedAccount, "Eligible", Total),
    bag_pack("Label", "Raw reported user", "Reported", WithRawUser, "Eligible", Total),
    bag_pack("Label", "Target agent user on invocation", "Reported", WithTargetUser, "Eligible", Invocations),
    bag_pack("Label", "Inference model metadata", "Reported", WithModel, "Eligible", Inference),
    bag_pack("Label", "Valid reported inference duration", "Reported", WithDuration, "Eligible", Inference),
    bag_pack("Label", "IsSatelliteProvider reported", "Reported", SatelliteReported, "Eligible", Total))
| mv-expand Measure = Measures
| extend Reported = tolong(Measure.Reported), Eligible = tolong(Measure.Eligible)
| project View = "Coverage", Label = tostring(Measure.Label), Count = Reported, Eligible,
    Percent = iff(Eligible == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * Reported / Eligible, 1)),
    Evidence = "Field population, not security/control effectiveness. Null percentage means no eligible events.";
let ErrorGroups = Events
| where HasError
| summarize Count = count(), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    Accounts = make_set_if(NormalizedAccount, isnotempty(NormalizedAccount), 8),
    RequestIds = make_set_if(RequestId, isnotempty(RequestId), 8)
    by ActionType, ToolName, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage
| top 30 by Count desc
| project View = "Errors", Label = coalesce(ToolName, ActionType), ActionType,
    Category = ErrorCode, Value = ErrorMessage, Count, LastSeen,
    Details = bag_pack("NormalizedAccounts", Accounts, "RequestIds", RequestIds);
let GraphAccounts = Associations | top 12 by Count desc;
let GraphTools = Tools | top 10 by Count desc;
let Edges = materialize(union
    (GraphAccounts | project SourceId = strcat("account:", Role, ":", Identity), TargetId = "agent",
        SourceLabel = Label, TargetLabel = SelectedId, SourceKind = Role, TargetKind = "Selected agent",
        Count, Evidence = "Reported account association on selected-agent events"),
    (GraphTools | project SourceId = "agent", TargetId = strcat("tool:", Label),
        SourceLabel = SelectedId, TargetLabel = Label, SourceKind = "Selected agent", TargetKind = "Observed tool",
        Count, Evidence = "Tool-name observation on selected-agent events"),
    (Events | where ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool" and isnotempty(ServerAddress)
        | extend Label = coalesce(ToolName, "(name not reported)")
        | where Label in (GraphTools | project Label)
        | summarize Count = count() by Label, ServerAddress
        | top 20 by Count desc
        | project SourceId = strcat("tool:", Label), TargetId = strcat("server:", ServerAddress),
            SourceLabel = Label, TargetLabel = ServerAddress, SourceKind = "Observed tool", TargetKind = "Reported server",
            Count, Evidence = "ServerAddress and tool reported on the same event; not proof of a network connection"));
let Nodes = union
    (Edges | project NodeId = SourceId, Label = SourceLabel, Category = SourceKind),
    (Edges | project NodeId = TargetId, Label = TargetLabel, Category = TargetKind)
| distinct NodeId, Label, Category
| project View = "Graph", NodeId, Label, Category;
let GraphEdges = Edges | project View = "Graph", SourceId, TargetId, Count, Evidence;
union Profile, Kpis, Timeline, Findings, Tools, Layers, Accounts, Models, Coverage, ErrorGroups, Nodes, GraphEdges
| where isnotempty(SelectedId)
| order by View asc, Sort asc nulls last, Time asc nulls last, Count desc nulls last, Label asc"}

content.json:
### Inventory coverage
Latest **AgentsInfo** snapshot per record/platform in the last **30 days**, separate from the activity window. Blueprint-only metadata is not the executing agent configuration. Missing owners, permissions or guardrails mean **not reported**, not absent.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let WindowStart = {TimeRange:start};
let WindowEnd = {TimeRange:end};
let CleanId = (value:string) {
    let s = trim(@"\s+", value);
    iff(s in~ ("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", "N/A"), "",
        iff(s matches regex @"^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
            tolower(s), s))
};
let PlatformKey = (value:string) { tolower(replace_regex(value, @"[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "")) };

let SelectedId = CleanId(iff("{InputMode}" == "Manual", base64_decode_tostring("{ManualAgentId:base64}"), base64_decode_tostring("{PickedAgentId:base64}")));
let ScopedEvents = () {
    CloudAppEvents
    | where isnotempty(SelectedId)
    | where Timestamp >= WindowStart and Timestamp < WindowEnd
    | where ActionType in ("InvokeAgent", "InferenceCall", "AISpanOutput",
        "ExecuteToolBySDK", "ExecuteToolByGateway", "ExecuteToolByMCPServer")
    | project Timestamp, ActionType, RawEventData, AdditionalFields, AccountObjectId, AccountId,
        AccountDisplayName, AccountType, Application, IPAddress, CountryCode,
        IsExternalUser, IsAnonymousProxy, IsImpersonated
| extend R = RawEventData, C = parse_json(tostring(RawEventData.CopilotEventData))
| extend AgentId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.TargetAgentId),
        coalesce(tostring(R.AgentId), tostring(C.AgentId)))),
    NativeId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.PlatformTargetAgentId),
        coalesce(tostring(R.PlatformAgentId), tostring(C.PlatformAgentId)))),
    AgentName = iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.TargetAgentName),
        coalesce(tostring(R.AgentName), tostring(C.AgentName))),
    AgentPlatform = iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.PlatformTargetAgentType),
        coalesce(tostring(R.PlatformAgentType), tostring(R.AgentPlatform), tostring(C.PlatformAgentType))),
    BlueprintId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent",
        coalesce(tostring(R.TargetAgentBlueprintId), tostring(R.TargetAgentBlueprintID), tostring(R.TargetBlueprintId)),
        tostring(R.AgentBlueprintId)))
    | where AgentId == SelectedId or NativeId == SelectedId
};
let Observed = materialize(ScopedEvents()
    | project AgentId, NativeId, Platform = PlatformKey(AgentPlatform), BlueprintId
    | distinct AgentId, NativeId, Platform, BlueprintId);
let AgentIds = Observed | where isnotempty(AgentId) | distinct AgentId;
let NativeKeys = Observed | where isnotempty(NativeId) and isnotempty(Platform)
    | project Key = strcat(Platform, "|", NativeId) | distinct Key;
let Blueprints = Observed | where isnotempty(BlueprintId) | distinct BlueprintId;
let Inventory = materialize(
    AgentsInfo
    | where isnotempty(SelectedId)
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | project Timestamp, InventoryId = CleanId(tostring(AgentId)), Platform = tostring(Platform),
        AgentName = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AgentName", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("Name", ""))),
        Description = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AgentDescription", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("Description", ""))),
        SourceAgentId = CleanId(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceAgentId", ""))),
        EntraAgentId = CleanId(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("EntraAgentId", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("EntraAgentID", "")))),
        EntraBlueprintId = CleanId(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("EntraBlueprintId", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("EntraBlueprintID", "")))),
        ObservabilityId = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("ObservabilityId", column_ifexists("ObservabilityID", dynamic(null))))),
        Version = tostring(column_ifexists("Version", "")),
        LifecycleStatus = tostring(column_ifexists("LifecycleStatus", "")),
        PublishedStatus = tostring(column_ifexists("PublishedStatus", "")),
        Availability = tostring(column_ifexists("Availability", "")),
        CreatedDateTime = todatetime(column_ifexists("CreatedDateTime", datetime(null))),
        LastPublishedDateTime = todatetime(column_ifexists("LastPublishedDateTime", datetime(null))),
        LastUpdatedDateTime = todatetime(column_ifexists("LastUpdatedDateTime", datetime(null))),
        InstanceCount = tolong(column_ifexists("InstanceCount", long(null))),
        Instructions = tostring(column_ifexists("Instructions", "")),
        Model = tostring(column_ifexists("Model", "")),
        Owners = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Owners", dynamic(null)))),
        Permissions = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Permissions", dynamic(null)))),
        ToolsAuthenticationType = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("ToolsAuthenticationType", dynamic(null)))),
        SharedWith = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("SharedWith", dynamic(null)))),
        Channels = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Channels", dynamic(null)))),
        Capabilities = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Capabilities", dynamic(null)))),
        DeclaredDataSources = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("DeclaredDataSources", dynamic(null)))),
        DeclaredTools = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("DeclaredTools", dynamic(null)))),
        McpServers = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("McpServers", dynamic(null)))),
        Skills = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Skills", dynamic(null)))),
        ConnectedAgents = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("ConnectedAgents", dynamic(null)))),
        Memory = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Memory", dynamic(null)))),
        Triggers = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Triggers", dynamic(null)))),
        Guardrails = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Guardrails", dynamic(null)))),
        Endpoints = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Endpoints", dynamic(null)))),
        RawAgentInfo = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("RawAgentInfo", dynamic(null))))
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, AgentName, Description, SourceAgentId, EntraAgentId, EntraBlueprintId,
        ObservabilityId, Version, LifecycleStatus, PublishedStatus, Availability, CreatedDateTime,
        LastPublishedDateTime, LastUpdatedDateTime, InstanceCount, Instructions, Model, Owners,
        Permissions, ToolsAuthenticationType, SharedWith, Channels, Capabilities, DeclaredDataSources,
        DeclaredTools, McpServers, Skills, ConnectedAgents, Memory, Triggers, Guardrails, Endpoints, RawAgentInfo)
        by InventoryId, Platform
    | extend BlueprintOnly = isnotempty(EntraBlueprintId) and isempty(EntraAgentId) and isempty(SourceAgentId)
        and (CleanId(tostring(ObservabilityId)) == EntraBlueprintId or set_has_element(ObservabilityId, EntraBlueprintId)
            or (EntraBlueprintId matches regex @"^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
                and set_has_element(parse_json(tolower(tostring(ObservabilityId))), EntraBlueprintId)))
    | extend DirectId = InventoryId == SelectedId,
        ExecutingMatch = not(BlueprintOnly) and InventoryId != EntraBlueprintId and InventoryId in (AgentIds),
        EntraMatch = isnotempty(EntraAgentId) and EntraAgentId != EntraBlueprintId
            and (EntraAgentId == SelectedId or EntraAgentId in (AgentIds)),
        NativeMatch = isnotempty(SourceAgentId) and SourceAgentId != EntraBlueprintId
            and strcat(PlatformKey(Platform), "|", SourceAgentId) in (NativeKeys),
        RelatedBlueprint = isnotempty(EntraBlueprintId) and EntraBlueprintId in (Blueprints)
    | where DirectId or ExecutingMatch or EntraMatch or NativeMatch or RelatedBlueprint
    | extend InstanceMatch = (DirectId and not(BlueprintOnly) and InventoryId != EntraBlueprintId)
        or ExecutingMatch or EntraMatch or NativeMatch
    | extend MatchBasis = strcat(
        iff(DirectId, "Selected ID = inventory AgentId; ", ""),
        iff(ExecutingMatch, "Observed AgentId = inventory AgentId; ", ""),
        iff(EntraMatch, "Selected/observed AgentId = EntraAgentId; ", ""),
        iff(NativeMatch, "Observed native ID = SourceAgentId within platform; ", ""),
        iff(RelatedBlueprint, "Blueprint relationship (not identity proof); ", ""),
        iff(BlueprintOnly, "Blueprint-only inventory record; ", ""))
);

let MatchCount = toscalar(Inventory | summarize countif(InstanceMatch));
let CandidateCount = toscalar(Inventory | count);
let Status = print View = "InventoryStatus", Label = "Inventory coverage",
    Value = case(CandidateCount == 0, "No match in 30 days",
        MatchCount == 0, "Relationship only",
        MatchCount == 1, "One instance candidate",
        "Ambiguous instance candidates"),
    Evidence = strcat(MatchCount, " instance candidates; ", CandidateCount, " total candidates. Not proof of management status."),
    Details = bag_pack("InstanceCandidates", MatchCount, "TotalCandidates", CandidateCount,
        "LookbackDays", 30, "DisplayedCandidateLimit", 20);
let Candidates = Inventory
| order by InstanceMatch desc, Timestamp desc
| take 20
| project View = "InventoryCandidates", Label = coalesce(AgentName, InventoryId),
    InventoryId, Platform, Category = iff(InstanceMatch, "Instance candidate", "Related / selected record"),
    LifecycleStatus, PublishedStatus, LastSeen = Timestamp, Evidence = MatchBasis,
    Details = bag_pack("Description", Description, "Version", Version, "SourceAgentId", SourceAgentId,
        "EntraAgentId", EntraAgentId, "EntraBlueprintId", EntraBlueprintId, "ObservabilityId", ObservabilityId,
        "Availability", Availability, "CreatedDateTime", CreatedDateTime, "LastPublishedDateTime", LastPublishedDateTime,
        "LastUpdatedDateTime", LastUpdatedDateTime, "InstanceCount", InstanceCount, "Instructions", Instructions,
        "Model", Model, "Owners", Owners, "Permissions", Permissions, "ToolsAuthenticationType", ToolsAuthenticationType,
        "SharedWith", SharedWith, "Channels", Channels, "Capabilities", Capabilities,
        "DeclaredDataSources", DeclaredDataSources, "DeclaredTools", DeclaredTools, "McpServers", McpServers,
        "Skills", Skills, "ConnectedAgents", ConnectedAgents, "Memory", Memory, "Triggers", Triggers,
        "Guardrails", Guardrails, "Endpoints", Endpoints, "RawAgentInfo", RawAgentInfo);
union Status, Candidates
| where isnotempty(SelectedId)"}

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let WindowStart = {TimeRange:start};
let WindowEnd = {TimeRange:end};
let CleanId = (value:string) {
    let s = trim(@"\s+", value);
    iff(s in~ ("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", "N/A"), "",
        iff(s matches regex @"^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
            tolower(s), s))
};
let PlatformKey = (value:string) { tolower(replace_regex(value, @"[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "")) };

let SelectedId = CleanId(iff("{InputMode}" == "Manual", base64_decode_tostring("{ManualAgentId:base64}"), base64_decode_tostring("{PickedAgentId:base64}")));
let ScopedEvents = () {
    CloudAppEvents
    | where isnotempty(SelectedId)
    | where Timestamp >= WindowStart and Timestamp < WindowEnd
    | where ActionType in ("InvokeAgent", "InferenceCall", "AISpanOutput",
        "ExecuteToolBySDK", "ExecuteToolByGateway", "ExecuteToolByMCPServer")
    | project Timestamp, ActionType, RawEventData, AdditionalFields, AccountObjectId, AccountId,
        AccountDisplayName, AccountType, Application, IPAddress, CountryCode,
        IsExternalUser, IsAnonymousProxy, IsImpersonated
| where "{ActionFocus}" == "All" or ActionType == "{ActionFocus}"
| extend R = RawEventData, C = parse_json(tostring(RawEventData.CopilotEventData))
| extend AgentId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.TargetAgentId),
        coalesce(tostring(R.AgentId), tostring(C.AgentId)))),
    NativeId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.PlatformTargetAgentId),
        coalesce(tostring(R.PlatformAgentId), tostring(C.PlatformAgentId)))),
    AgentName = iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.TargetAgentName),
        coalesce(tostring(R.AgentName), tostring(C.AgentName))),
    AgentPlatform = iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.PlatformTargetAgentType),
        coalesce(tostring(R.PlatformAgentType), tostring(R.AgentPlatform), tostring(C.PlatformAgentType))),
    BlueprintId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent",
        coalesce(tostring(R.TargetAgentBlueprintId), tostring(R.TargetAgentBlueprintID), tostring(R.TargetBlueprintId)),
        tostring(R.AgentBlueprintId)))
    | where AgentId == SelectedId or NativeId == SelectedId
};
let Events = materialize(
    ScopedEvents()
    | extend ToolName = coalesce(tostring(R.ToolName), tostring(R.toolName), tostring(R["gen_ai.tool.name"])),
        ToolType = tostring(R.ToolType), ToolServer = tostring(R.ToolServerName),
        ServerAddress = tostring(R.ServerAddress), ToolDescription = tostring(R.ToolDescription),
        ToolId = tostring(R.ToolId), TraceId = coalesce(tostring(R.TraceId), tostring(C.TraceId), tostring(R.traceId)),
        ConversationId = coalesce(tostring(R.ConversationId), tostring(C.ConversationId)),
        ThreadId = coalesce(tostring(R.ThreadId), tostring(C.ThreadId)),
        RequestId = coalesce(tostring(R.RequestId), tostring(C.RequestId)),
        SpanId = tostring(R.OpId), ParentSpanId = tostring(R.ParentId),
        RawUserId = tostring(R.UserId), RawUserKey = CleanId(tostring(R.UserKey)),
        TargetUserId = tostring(R.TargetAgentUserId), TargetUserKey = CleanId(tostring(R.TargetAgentUserKey)),
        ErrorMessage = coalesce(tostring(R.ErrorMessage), tostring(C.ErrorMessage)),
        ErrorCode = coalesce(tostring(R.ErrorCode), tostring(R.ErrorType), tostring(C.ErrorType)),
        Channel = coalesce(tostring(R.ChannelName), tostring(C.ChannelName)),
        ModelMetadata = parse_json(tostring(C.ModelTransparencyDetails)),
        SpanStart = todatetime(R.CreationTime),
        SpanEnd = coalesce(todatetime(R.CompletionTime), todatetime(C.CompletionTime)),
        Satellite = tobool(AdditionalFields.IsSatelliteProvider),
        TraceConflict = isnotempty(tostring(R.TraceId)) and isnotempty(tostring(C.TraceId))
            and tostring(R.TraceId) != tostring(C.TraceId),
        ConversationConflict = isnotempty(tostring(R.ConversationId)) and isnotempty(tostring(C.ConversationId))
            and tostring(R.ConversationId) != tostring(C.ConversationId)
    | extend HasError = isnotempty(ErrorMessage) or isnotempty(ErrorCode),
        NormalizedAccount = coalesce(CleanId(AccountObjectId), AccountId),
        RawUser = coalesce(RawUserKey, RawUserId),
        TargetUser = coalesce(TargetUserKey, TargetUserId),
        DurationMs = iff(isnotnull(SpanStart) and isnotnull(SpanEnd) and SpanEnd >= SpanStart,
            datetime_diff("millisecond", SpanEnd, SpanStart), long(null)),
        InvalidDuration = isnotnull(SpanStart) and isnotnull(SpanEnd) and SpanEnd < SpanStart,
        ToolPhase = case(ToolType startswith "MCP:Initialize", "MCP initialization",
            ToolType startswith "MCP:ListTools", "MCP discovery",
            ToolType startswith "MCP:CallTool", "Explicit MCP call",
            ToolType =~ "function", "Function observation",
            ToolType =~ "RemoteMCP", "Remote MCP observation",
            ToolType =~ "CodefulServer", "Server observation", "Other / unspecified")
    | project Timestamp, ActionType, AgentId, NativeId, AgentName, AgentPlatform, BlueprintId,
        Channel, Application, ToolName, ToolType, ToolServer, ServerAddress, ToolDescription, ToolId,
        TraceId, ConversationId, ThreadId, RequestId, SpanId, ParentSpanId,
        AccountObjectId, AccountId, AccountDisplayName, AccountType, NormalizedAccount,
        RawUser, RawUserId, RawUserKey, TargetUser, TargetUserId, TargetUserKey,
        ErrorMessage, ErrorCode, HasError, IPAddress, CountryCode, IsExternalUser,
        IsAnonymousProxy, IsImpersonated, ModelMetadata, DurationMs, InvalidDuration,
        Satellite, TraceConflict, ConversationConflict, ToolPhase
);
let ToolCount = toscalar(Events | where ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool" and isnotempty(ToolName)
    | distinct ToolName | count);
let S = materialize(Events
| summarize Total = count(), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    Invocations = countif(ActionType == "InvokeAgent"), Inference = countif(ActionType == "InferenceCall"),
    ToolEvents = countif(ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool"), Outputs = countif(ActionType == "AISpanOutput"),
    ErrorEvents = countif(HasError), AdminEvents = countif(AccountType =~ "Admin"),
    WithTrace = countif(isnotempty(TraceId)), WithAccountObjectId = countif(isnotempty(AccountObjectId)),
    WithNormalizedAccount = countif(isnotempty(NormalizedAccount)), WithRawUser = countif(isnotempty(RawUser)),
    WithTargetUser = countif(ActionType == "InvokeAgent" and isnotempty(TargetUser)),
    WithModel = countif(ActionType == "InferenceCall" and tostring(ModelMetadata) !in ("", "[]", "{}", "null")),
    WithDuration = countif(ActionType == "InferenceCall" and isnotnull(DurationMs)),
    InvalidDurations = countif(InvalidDuration), TraceConflicts = countif(TraceConflict),
    ConversationConflicts = countif(ConversationConflict), ExternalEvents = countif(IsExternalUser == true),
    ProxyEvents = countif(IsAnonymousProxy == true), ImpersonatedEvents = countif(IsImpersonated == true),
    SatelliteReported = countif(isnotnull(Satellite)), SatelliteTrue = countif(Satellite == true),
    Names = make_set_if(AgentName, isnotempty(AgentName), 32),
    Platforms = make_set_if(AgentPlatform, isnotempty(AgentPlatform), 32),
    AgentIds = make_set_if(AgentId, isnotempty(AgentId), 32),
    NativeIds = make_set_if(NativeId, isnotempty(NativeId), 32),
    Blueprints = make_set_if(BlueprintId, isnotempty(BlueprintId), 32),
    Channels = make_set_if(Channel, isnotempty(Channel), 32),
    Applications = make_set_if(Application, isnotempty(Application), 32),
    Conversations = dcountif(ConversationId, isnotempty(ConversationId))
);
let Profile = S
| extend Properties = bag_pack("Selected ID", SelectedId, "Observed names", Names,
    "Platforms", Platforms, "Channels", Channels, "Applications", Applications,
    "First observed in window (UTC)", FirstSeen, "Last observed in window (UTC)", LastSeen,
    "Executing / target IDs", AgentIds, "Native IDs", NativeIds, "Blueprint references", Blueprints,
    "Identity scope", case(array_length(AgentIds) > 1, "Multiple executing IDs match this input; review native-ID ambiguity.",
        array_length(Platforms) > 1, "One selected identity with multiple platform labels; not automatically an identity collision.",
        "Exact executing/target or native ID; caller-only invocations excluded."),
    "Visibility", iff(Total == 0, "No observed events in this window. Not proof of inactivity.",
        "Observed telemetry; counts are not successful operations."),
    "Conversation IDs (approximate)", Conversations)
| mv-expand Label = bag_keys(Properties) to typeof(string)
| project View = "Profile", Label, Value = tostring(Properties[Label]);
let Kpis = S
| extend Cards = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Label", "Observed events", "Value", tostring(Total), "Note", "All selected event families", "Order", 1),
    bag_pack("Label", "Observed tool names", "Value", tostring(ToolCount), "Note", "Distinct names, not calls", "Order", 2),
    bag_pack("Label", "Admin-associated events", "Value", tostring(AdminEvents), "Note", "Reported AccountType; not effective privilege", "Order", 3),
    bag_pack("Label", "Error-bearing events", "Value", tostring(ErrorEvents), "Note", "Not deduplicated failed operations", "Order", 4),
    bag_pack("Label", "Trace coverage", "Value", iff(Total == 0, "N/A", strcat(round(100.0 * WithTrace / Total, 1), "%")),
        "Note", "Nonempty extracted TraceId", "Order", 5),
    bag_pack("Label", "Inference events", "Value", tostring(Inference), "Note", "Model identity may be unreported", "Order", 6))
| mv-expand Card = Cards
| project View = "Kpis", Label = tostring(Card.Label), Value = tostring(Card.Value),
    Evidence = tostring(Card.Note), Sort = tolong(Card.Order);
let Grain = case(WindowEnd - WindowStart <= 6h, 5m, WindowEnd - WindowStart <= 1d, 30m,
    WindowEnd - WindowStart <= 7d, 3h, 12h);
let Timeline = Events
| summarize Invocations = countif(ActionType == "InvokeAgent"),
    Inference = countif(ActionType == "InferenceCall"), Tools = countif(ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool"),
    Outputs = countif(ActionType == "AISpanOutput") by Time = bin(Timestamp, Grain)
| project View = "Timeline", Time, Invocations, Inference, Tools, Outputs;
let Findings = union
    (S | where Total == 0 | project View = "Findings", Category = "Visibility", Label = "No activity in this window",
        Value = "No selected events returned", Evidence = "This does not establish inactivity or missing controls.",
        NextStep = "Check the ID and deliberately widen the time window.", Sort = long(0)),
    (S | where ErrorEvents > 0 | project View = "Findings", Category = "Investigate", Label = "Reported errors",
        Value = strcat(ErrorEvents, " error-bearing events"), Evidence = "An operation may be reported at multiple layers.",
        NextStep = "Review the error groups and tool reporting layers below.", Sort = long(1)),
    (S | where AdminEvents > 0 | project View = "Findings", Category = "Review", Label = "Admin-associated activity",
        Value = strcat(AdminEvents, " events"), Evidence = "AccountType is a reported label, not proof of privilege use.",
        NextStep = "Review normalized event accounts, actions and tools; verify permissions separately.", Sort = long(2)),
    (S | where Total > 0 and WithTrace < Total | project View = "Findings", Category = "Visibility", Label = "Incomplete trace coverage",
        Value = strcat(Total - WithTrace, " events without TraceId"), Evidence = "Conversation, request and span IDs remain separate pivots.",
        NextStep = "Inspect instrumentation. Do not reconstruct complete runs from timestamps alone.", Sort = long(3)),
    (S | where Inference > WithModel | project View = "Findings", Category = "Visibility", Label = "Model metadata not reported",
        Value = strcat(Inference - WithModel, " of ", Inference, " inference events"),
        Evidence = "Expected source: CopilotEventData.ModelTransparencyDetails.",
        NextStep = "Check emitter metadata; do not infer the model from tool or agent names.", Sort = long(4)),
    (S | where Total > WithAccountObjectId | project View = "Findings", Category = "Visibility", Label = "Incomplete account object IDs",
        Value = strcat(Total - WithAccountObjectId, " events"), Evidence = "AccountId and raw user fields can still be populated.",
        NextStep = "Compare the three reported account roles below. Missing object IDs do not mean anonymous.", Sort = long(5)),
    (S | where ExternalEvents + ProxyEvents + ImpersonatedEvents > 0
        | project View = "Findings", Category = "Review", Label = "Reported account/network signals",
        Value = strcat("External: ", ExternalEvents, "; proxy: ", ProxyEvents, "; impersonated: ", ImpersonatedEvents),
        Evidence = "Signals can overlap; service accounts and notifications need context.",
        NextStep = "Inspect event evidence and expected behavior before classifying a threat.", Sort = long(6)),
    (S | where TraceConflicts + ConversationConflicts + InvalidDurations > 0
        | project View = "Findings", Category = "Visibility", Label = "Telemetry consistency",
        Value = strcat("Trace conflicts: ", TraceConflicts, "; conversation conflicts: ", ConversationConflicts,
            "; invalid durations: ", InvalidDurations),
        Evidence = "These are telemetry quality findings, not validated detections.",
        NextStep = "Compare raw/nested correlation fields and reported timestamps.", Sort = long(7));
let Tools = materialize(Events
| where ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool"
| summarize Count = count(), Errors = countif(HasError), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    Layers = make_set(strcat(ActionType, " / ", ToolPhase), 8),
    Servers = make_set_if(ToolServer, isnotempty(ToolServer), 8),
    Addresses = make_set_if(ServerAddress, isnotempty(ServerAddress), 8),
    Descriptions = make_set_if(ToolDescription, isnotempty(ToolDescription), 4),
    SetupEvents = countif(ToolPhase in ("MCP initialization", "MCP discovery")),
    ToolIdsReported = countif(isnotempty(ToolId))
    by ToolName
| extend Label = coalesce(ToolName, "(name not reported)"),
    Category = case(ToolName contains "mail" or ToolName contains "message", "Mail-related (name-inferred)",
        ToolName in~ ("findSite", "findFileOrFolder"), "SharePoint discovery (name-inferred)",
        ToolName contains "profile", "Identity/profile (name-inferred)", "Unclassified")
| order by Errors desc, Count desc, Label asc
| take 50
| project View = "Tools", Label, Category, Count, Errors, LastSeen,
    Evidence = "Names/descriptions do not prove permissions or data retrieval. Events are not deduplicated calls.",
    Details = bag_pack("ReportingLayers", Layers, "ToolServers", Servers, "ReportedAddresses", Addresses,
        "Descriptions", Descriptions, "SetupDiscoveryEvents", SetupEvents, "EventsWithToolId", ToolIdsReported));
let Layers = Events
| where ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool"
| summarize Count = count(), Errors = countif(HasError), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by ToolName, ActionType, ToolPhase, ToolType, ToolServer, ServerAddress
| order by Errors desc, Count desc
| take 100
| project View = "Layers", Label = coalesce(ToolName, "(name not reported)"), ActionType,
    Category = ToolPhase, ToolType, ToolServer, ServerAddress, Count, Errors, LastSeen;
let Associations = materialize(Events
| extend Identities = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Role", "Normalized event account", "Identity", NormalizedAccount,
        "Name", coalesce(AccountDisplayName, NormalizedAccount), "AccountType", AccountType,
        "Source", "AccountObjectId / AccountId / AccountDisplayName"),
    bag_pack("Role", "Raw reported user", "Identity", RawUser,
        "Name", coalesce(RawUserId, RawUser), "AccountType", "",
        "Source", "RawEventData.UserKey / UserId"),
    bag_pack("Role", "Target agent user", "Identity", TargetUser,
        "Name", coalesce(TargetUserId, TargetUser), "AccountType", "",
        "Source", "RawEventData.TargetAgentUserKey / TargetAgentUserId"))
| mv-expand IdentityEntry = Identities
| extend Identity = tostring(IdentityEntry.Identity), Role = tostring(IdentityEntry.Role),
    Name = tostring(IdentityEntry.Name), ReportedType = tostring(IdentityEntry.AccountType),
    Source = tostring(IdentityEntry.Source)
| where isnotempty(Identity)
| summarize Count = count(), Errors = countif(HasError), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    Names = make_set(Name, 8), Types = make_set_if(ReportedType, isnotempty(ReportedType), 8),
    Actions = make_set(ActionType, 8), ToolNames = make_set_if(ToolName, isnotempty(ToolName), 16),
    IPs = make_set_if(IPAddress, isnotempty(IPAddress), 16),
    Countries = make_set_if(CountryCode, isnotempty(CountryCode), 16),
    ExternalSignals = countif(IsExternalUser == true), ProxySignals = countif(IsAnonymousProxy == true),
    ImpersonatedSignals = countif(IsImpersonated == true)
    by Role, Identity, Source
| extend Label = strcat_array(Names, ", "));
let Accounts = Associations
| order by Count desc, Role asc, Identity asc
| take 50
| project View = "Accounts", Label, Role, Identity, Count, Errors, LastSeen, Evidence = Source,
    Details = bag_pack("ReportedAccountTypes", Types, "ActionTypes", Actions, "ObservedTools", ToolNames,
        "IPs", IPs, "Countries", Countries, "ExternalSignals", ExternalSignals,
        "ProxySignals", ProxySignals, "ImpersonatedSignals", ImpersonatedSignals);
let Models = Events
| where ActionType == "InferenceCall"
| extend ModelEntries = case(gettype(ModelMetadata) == "array" and array_length(ModelMetadata) > 0, ModelMetadata,
    gettype(ModelMetadata) == "dictionary" and array_length(bag_keys(ModelMetadata)) > 0, pack_array(ModelMetadata),
    dynamic([{}]))
| mv-expand Entry = ModelEntries
| extend Label = coalesce(tostring(Entry.ModelName), "(model not reported)"),
    Category = coalesce(tostring(Entry.ModelProviderName), "(provider not reported)")
| summarize Count = count(), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), ValidDurations = countif(isnotnull(DurationMs)),
    AverageMs = avg(DurationMs), P95Ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by Label, Category
| top 30 by Count desc
| project View = "Models", Label, Category, Count, LastSeen,
    Evidence = "Metadata entries, not unique calls; a multi-model event can appear more than once.",
    Details = bag_pack("ValidDurationEntries", ValidDurations, "AverageReportedMs", AverageMs, "P95ReportedMs", P95Ms);
let Coverage = S
| extend Measures = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Label", "Trace ID", "Reported", WithTrace, "Eligible", Total),
    bag_pack("Label", "Normalized account object ID", "Reported", WithAccountObjectId, "Eligible", Total),
    bag_pack("Label", "Normalized account ID (object ID or AccountId)", "Reported", WithNormalizedAccount, "Eligible", Total),
    bag_pack("Label", "Raw reported user", "Reported", WithRawUser, "Eligible", Total),
    bag_pack("Label", "Target agent user on invocation", "Reported", WithTargetUser, "Eligible", Invocations),
    bag_pack("Label", "Inference model metadata", "Reported", WithModel, "Eligible", Inference),
    bag_pack("Label", "Valid reported inference duration", "Reported", WithDuration, "Eligible", Inference),
    bag_pack("Label", "IsSatelliteProvider reported", "Reported", SatelliteReported, "Eligible", Total))
| mv-expand Measure = Measures
| extend Reported = tolong(Measure.Reported), Eligible = tolong(Measure.Eligible)
| project View = "Coverage", Label = tostring(Measure.Label), Count = Reported, Eligible,
    Percent = iff(Eligible == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * Reported / Eligible, 1)),
    Evidence = "Field population, not security/control effectiveness. Null percentage means no eligible events.";
let ErrorGroups = Events
| where HasError
| summarize Count = count(), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    Accounts = make_set_if(NormalizedAccount, isnotempty(NormalizedAccount), 8),
    RequestIds = make_set_if(RequestId, isnotempty(RequestId), 8)
    by ActionType, ToolName, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage
| top 30 by Count desc
| project View = "Errors", Label = coalesce(ToolName, ActionType), ActionType,
    Category = ErrorCode, Value = ErrorMessage, Count, LastSeen,
    Details = bag_pack("NormalizedAccounts", Accounts, "RequestIds", RequestIds);
let GraphAccounts = Associations | top 12 by Count desc;
let GraphTools = Tools | top 10 by Count desc;
let Edges = materialize(union
    (GraphAccounts | project SourceId = strcat("account:", Role, ":", Identity), TargetId = "agent",
        SourceLabel = Label, TargetLabel = SelectedId, SourceKind = Role, TargetKind = "Selected agent",
        Count, Evidence = "Reported account association on selected-agent events"),
    (GraphTools | project SourceId = "agent", TargetId = strcat("tool:", Label),
        SourceLabel = SelectedId, TargetLabel = Label, SourceKind = "Selected agent", TargetKind = "Observed tool",
        Count, Evidence = "Tool-name observation on selected-agent events"),
    (Events | where ActionType startswith "ExecuteTool" and isnotempty(ServerAddress)
        | extend Label = coalesce(ToolName, "(name not reported)")
        | where Label in (GraphTools | project Label)
        | summarize Count = count() by Label, ServerAddress
        | top 20 by Count desc
        | project SourceId = strcat("tool:", Label), TargetId = strcat("server:", ServerAddress),
            SourceLabel = Label, TargetLabel = ServerAddress, SourceKind = "Observed tool", TargetKind = "Reported server",
            Count, Evidence = "ServerAddress and tool reported on the same event; not proof of a network connection"));
let Nodes = union
    (Edges | project NodeId = SourceId, Label = SourceLabel, Category = SourceKind),
    (Edges | project NodeId = TargetId, Label = TargetLabel, Category = TargetKind)
| distinct NodeId, Label, Category
| project View = "Graph", NodeId, Label, Category;
let GraphEdges = Edges | project View = "Graph", SourceId, TargetId, Count, Evidence;
union Profile, Kpis, Timeline, Findings, Tools, Layers, Accounts, Models, Coverage, ErrorGroups, Nodes, GraphEdges
| where isnotempty(SelectedId)
| order by View asc, Sort asc nulls last, Time asc nulls last, Count desc nulls last, Label asc"}

content.json:
### Inventory coverage
Latest **AgentsInfo** snapshot per record/platform in the last **30 days**, separate from the activity window. Blueprint-only metadata is not the executing agent configuration. Missing owners, permissions or guardrails mean **not reported**, not absent.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let WindowStart = {TimeRange:start};
let WindowEnd = {TimeRange:end};
let CleanId = (value:string) {
    let s = trim(@"\s+", value);
    iff(s in~ ("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", "N/A"), "",
        iff(s matches regex @"^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
            tolower(s), s))
};
let PlatformKey = (value:string) { tolower(replace_regex(value, @"[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "")) };

let SelectedId = CleanId(iff("{InputMode}" == "Manual", base64_decode_tostring("{ManualAgentId:base64}"), base64_decode_tostring("{PickedAgentId:base64}")));
let ScopedEvents = () {
    CloudAppEvents
    | where isnotempty(SelectedId)
    | where Timestamp >= WindowStart and Timestamp < WindowEnd
    | where ActionType in ("InvokeAgent", "InferenceCall", "AISpanOutput",
        "ExecuteToolBySDK", "ExecuteToolByGateway", "ExecuteToolByMCPServer")
    | project Timestamp, ActionType, RawEventData, AdditionalFields, AccountObjectId, AccountId,
        AccountDisplayName, AccountType, Application, IPAddress, CountryCode,
        IsExternalUser, IsAnonymousProxy, IsImpersonated
| extend R = RawEventData, C = parse_json(tostring(RawEventData.CopilotEventData))
| extend AgentId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.TargetAgentId),
        coalesce(tostring(R.AgentId), tostring(C.AgentId)))),
    NativeId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.PlatformTargetAgentId),
        coalesce(tostring(R.PlatformAgentId), tostring(C.PlatformAgentId)))),
    AgentName = iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.TargetAgentName),
        coalesce(tostring(R.AgentName), tostring(C.AgentName))),
    AgentPlatform = iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent", tostring(R.PlatformTargetAgentType),
        coalesce(tostring(R.PlatformAgentType), tostring(R.AgentPlatform), tostring(C.PlatformAgentType))),
    BlueprintId = CleanId(iff(ActionType == "InvokeAgent",
        coalesce(tostring(R.TargetAgentBlueprintId), tostring(R.TargetAgentBlueprintID), tostring(R.TargetBlueprintId)),
        tostring(R.AgentBlueprintId)))
    | where AgentId == SelectedId or NativeId == SelectedId
};
let Observed = materialize(ScopedEvents()
    | project AgentId, NativeId, Platform = PlatformKey(AgentPlatform), BlueprintId
    | distinct AgentId, NativeId, Platform, BlueprintId);
let AgentIds = Observed | where isnotempty(AgentId) | distinct AgentId;
let NativeKeys = Observed | where isnotempty(NativeId) and isnotempty(Platform)
    | project Key = strcat(Platform, "|", NativeId) | distinct Key;
let Blueprints = Observed | where isnotempty(BlueprintId) | distinct BlueprintId;
let Inventory = materialize(
    AgentsInfo
    | where isnotempty(SelectedId)
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | project Timestamp, InventoryId = CleanId(tostring(AgentId)), Platform = tostring(Platform),
        AgentName = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AgentName", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("Name", ""))),
        Description = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AgentDescription", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("Description", ""))),
        SourceAgentId = CleanId(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceAgentId", ""))),
        EntraAgentId = CleanId(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("EntraAgentId", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("EntraAgentID", "")))),
        EntraBlueprintId = CleanId(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("EntraBlueprintId", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("EntraBlueprintID", "")))),
        ObservabilityId = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("ObservabilityId", column_ifexists("ObservabilityID", dynamic(null))))),
        Version = tostring(column_ifexists("Version", "")),
        LifecycleStatus = tostring(column_ifexists("LifecycleStatus", "")),
        PublishedStatus = tostring(column_ifexists("PublishedStatus", "")),
        Availability = tostring(column_ifexists("Availability", "")),
        CreatedDateTime = todatetime(column_ifexists("CreatedDateTime", datetime(null))),
        LastPublishedDateTime = todatetime(column_ifexists("LastPublishedDateTime", datetime(null))),
        LastUpdatedDateTime = todatetime(column_ifexists("LastUpdatedDateTime", datetime(null))),
        InstanceCount = tolong(column_ifexists("InstanceCount", long(null))),
        Instructions = tostring(column_ifexists("Instructions", "")),
        Model = tostring(column_ifexists("Model", "")),
        Owners = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Owners", dynamic(null)))),
        Permissions = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Permissions", dynamic(null)))),
        ToolsAuthenticationType = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("ToolsAuthenticationType", dynamic(null)))),
        SharedWith = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("SharedWith", dynamic(null)))),
        Channels = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Channels", dynamic(null)))),
        Capabilities = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Capabilities", dynamic(null)))),
        DeclaredDataSources = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("DeclaredDataSources", dynamic(null)))),
        DeclaredTools = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("DeclaredTools", dynamic(null)))),
        McpServers = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("McpServers", dynamic(null)))),
        Skills = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Skills", dynamic(null)))),
        ConnectedAgents = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("ConnectedAgents", dynamic(null)))),
        Memory = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Memory", dynamic(null)))),
        Triggers = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Triggers", dynamic(null)))),
        Guardrails = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Guardrails", dynamic(null)))),
        Endpoints = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("Endpoints", dynamic(null)))),
        RawAgentInfo = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists("RawAgentInfo", dynamic(null))))
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, AgentName, Description, SourceAgentId, EntraAgentId, EntraBlueprintId,
        ObservabilityId, Version, LifecycleStatus, PublishedStatus, Availability, CreatedDateTime,
        LastPublishedDateTime, LastUpdatedDateTime, InstanceCount, Instructions, Model, Owners,
        Permissions, ToolsAuthenticationType, SharedWith, Channels, Capabilities, DeclaredDataSources,
        DeclaredTools, McpServers, Skills, ConnectedAgents, Memory, Triggers, Guardrails, Endpoints, RawAgentInfo)
        by InventoryId, Platform
    | extend BlueprintOnly = isnotempty(EntraBlueprintId) and isempty(EntraAgentId) and isempty(SourceAgentId)
        and (CleanId(tostring(ObservabilityId)) == EntraBlueprintId or set_has_element(ObservabilityId, EntraBlueprintId)
            or (EntraBlueprintId matches regex @"^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
                and set_has_element(parse_json(tolower(tostring(ObservabilityId))), EntraBlueprintId)))
    | extend DirectId = InventoryId == SelectedId,
        ExecutingMatch = not(BlueprintOnly) and InventoryId != EntraBlueprintId and InventoryId in (AgentIds),
        EntraMatch = isnotempty(EntraAgentId) and EntraAgentId != EntraBlueprintId
            and (EntraAgentId == SelectedId or EntraAgentId in (AgentIds)),
        NativeMatch = isnotempty(SourceAgentId) and SourceAgentId != EntraBlueprintId
            and strcat(PlatformKey(Platform), "|", SourceAgentId) in (NativeKeys),
        RelatedBlueprint = isnotempty(EntraBlueprintId) and EntraBlueprintId in (Blueprints)
    | where DirectId or ExecutingMatch or EntraMatch or NativeMatch or RelatedBlueprint
    | extend InstanceMatch = (DirectId and not(BlueprintOnly) and InventoryId != EntraBlueprintId)
        or ExecutingMatch or EntraMatch or NativeMatch
    | extend MatchBasis = strcat(
        iff(DirectId, "Selected ID = inventory AgentId; ", ""),
        iff(ExecutingMatch, "Observed AgentId = inventory AgentId; ", ""),
        iff(EntraMatch, "Selected/observed AgentId = EntraAgentId; ", ""),
        iff(NativeMatch, "Observed native ID = SourceAgentId within platform; ", ""),
        iff(RelatedBlueprint, "Blueprint relationship (not identity proof); ", ""),
        iff(BlueprintOnly, "Blueprint-only inventory record; ", ""))
);

let MatchCount = toscalar(Inventory | summarize countif(InstanceMatch));
let CandidateCount = toscalar(Inventory | count);
let Status = print View = "InventoryStatus", Label = "Inventory coverage",
    Value = case(CandidateCount == 0, "No match in 30 days",
        MatchCount == 0, "Relationship only",
        MatchCount == 1, "One instance candidate",
        "Ambiguous instance candidates"),
    Evidence = strcat(MatchCount, " instance candidates; ", CandidateCount, " total candidates. Not proof of management status."),
    Details = bag_pack("InstanceCandidates", MatchCount, "TotalCandidates", CandidateCount,
        "LookbackDays", 30, "DisplayedCandidateLimit", 20);
let Candidates = Inventory
| order by InstanceMatch desc, Timestamp desc
| take 20
| project View = "InventoryCandidates", Label = coalesce(AgentName, InventoryId),
    InventoryId, Platform, Category = iff(InstanceMatch, "Instance candidate", "Related / selected record"),
    LifecycleStatus, PublishedStatus, LastSeen = Timestamp, Evidence = MatchBasis,
    Details = bag_pack("Description", Description, "Version", Version, "SourceAgentId", SourceAgentId,
        "EntraAgentId", EntraAgentId, "EntraBlueprintId", EntraBlueprintId, "ObservabilityId", ObservabilityId,
        "Availability", Availability, "CreatedDateTime", CreatedDateTime, "LastPublishedDateTime", LastPublishedDateTime,
        "LastUpdatedDateTime", LastUpdatedDateTime, "InstanceCount", InstanceCount, "Instructions", Instructions,
        "Model", Model, "Owners", Owners, "Permissions", Permissions, "ToolsAuthenticationType", ToolsAuthenticationType,
        "SharedWith", SharedWith, "Channels", Channels, "Capabilities", Capabilities,
        "DeclaredDataSources", DeclaredDataSources, "DeclaredTools", DeclaredTools, "McpServers", McpServers,
        "Skills", Skills, "ConnectedAgents", ConnectedAgents, "Memory", Memory, "Triggers", Triggers,
        "Guardrails", Guardrails, "Endpoints", Endpoints, "RawAgentInfo", RawAgentInfo);
union Status, Candidates
| where isnotempty(SelectedId)"}
